description: §14.8.9 S443 round 6 (L4) — deleting a row copy's Symbol-keyed properties removes the protected-column descriptor; returning the copy is E-PROTECT-006 (every protected column of the row may ship).
rationale: §14.8.9: "`reveal` is the only path that re-admits a protected-origin column". The descriptor lives on the row under a Symbol key; `{...u}` then `delete c[k]` for each of `Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(c)` served the full row over HTTP (measured, S443 round 6). The runtime descriptor is now frozen and non-configurable on the tagged row; on a copy, a property write or delete by a key that may be that Symbol makes the compiler treat every column of the row as shipping.
